add.k: Victor von Doom's aide at Von Doom Industries
st: Leonard, Victor's aide, preps his press and fetches Ben Grimm for him, then watches the frozen Doom shipped to Latveria.

files.notes: Only 'Leonard' is said ('Leonard? Bring Ben Grimm to the Baxter Building', 'I'll take it from here, Leonard'); the surname Kirk is not said, so n is Leonard. A different person from the app's other Leonard. He asks if the trip will help the stock ('Reed's always right'), briefs Victor on the IPO and press. The shipping to Latveria scene is from the MCU wiki page (transcript lines unlabeled). Raft file as Doom's loyal aide; op/opp are loose, he only fetches Ben for Doom's plan.

add.k: A banker backing Von Doom Industries
st: Ned Cecil gives Victor a week to save his stock, pulls the bank's support, and is killed by Victor's new powers.

files.notes: Named on screen: Victor calls him 'Ned' ('Ned, I can turn this around'; 'Nothing personal, Ned') and a TV report says 'Ned Cecil announced that his group of investors would seek to gain control'. His bank and investor group are never named, so tm is Independent. Victim file.

add.k: An interrogator brought in by General Hager
tm: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
opp: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
st: Brought in by General Hager, Mr. Sherman questions the captured Silver Surfer, saying human-rights rules don't bind him.
Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer

files.notes: Hager names him twice ('Mr. Sherman.'; 'Mr. Sherman, let's take a break.'). His lines: 'There are certain things I'm not permitted to do... because they're considered human-rights violations. Fortunately, you're not human.' and 'You should really be a little more cooperative.' Screen never says whom he works for (he is 'Mr.', not ranked), so Independent. op is the Surfer he tortures; no hero confronts him directly.

add.k: A young Inhuman who can see the future
st: After his Terrigenesis, Bronaja becomes Maximus's seer, warns him of plots and foresees him ruling Attilan alone.

files.notes: Named many times (Terrigenesis ceremony 'Iridia and Bronaja', Maximus 'You, Bronaja, are special'). The site's s01e01 transcript is the two-part premiere and covers episode 2 too: in episode 2 he tells Maximus the Genetic Council plans his death and Maximus visits him and Loyolis. E6: Maximus catches his lie about Tibor and makes him say 'Long live King Maximus'; E8: 'I saw you as the undisputed king of Attilan.' Lower caste, no group named: Independent. A pawn of Maximus, so a Compound file.

add.k: A plant-controlling Inhuman of Attilan's Royal Guard
st: Flora, a plant-controlling Royal Guard, hunts the Royal Family on Oahu with Auran and Mordis, then is sent back to Attilan.

files.notes: A different person from the app's other Flora. Named and speaking in E3 ('Hey, Flora... Can't you make a path'), E6 ('Auran, Flora, Mordis'; 'FLORA: It's Karnak.'). Wikipedia's cast notes list 103 to 107; in E7 Auran's party is returned to Maximus under parley ('We return your team as an act of good faith'). Group uses the app's 'Royal Guard'.

add.k: A Honolulu police captain holding Black Bolt
st: Captain Pena stonewalls the press and Louise about his prisoner and puts Black Bolt in general population to rattle him.

files.notes: Named by reporters in E3 ('Captain Pena, how about a statement?'). 'Put him in gen pop, but stick it to him'; threatens to tow Louise's car with her in it. The police department is never named on screen (only 'police in downtown Honolulu' on the news), so tm is Independent. Not in episode 2: the episode 2 half of the s01e01 transcript has the arrest but no Pena, and the MCU wiki credits list him in 1.03 only.

add.k: A Church of Gibborim elder who has known Leslie since birth
st: In season 1, Aura serves the Deans at the Church of Gibborim and falls for Chase and Molly's runaway disguises.
In season 2, Aura rides in a church van the Runaways hack, then sides with Frank and refuses to let Leslie close the church.

files.notes: Named in S1E10 ('I can't believe Aura and Frances bought it'), S2E5, S2E7 ('What are you doing, Aura?'), S2E8 ('Aura, Frances, we have a problem'), S2E10 (speaker-labelled AURA: 'Leslie, I've known you since the day you were born'). Wikipedia cast notes list 101, 102, 105, 110, 205, 207, 208, 210, 211; her S1 scenes before E10 are not tied to her name in the subtitles. Vaughn steals 'Aura's Crater map' in S2E12. Not seen in S3 (credited seasons 1 to 2).

add.k: A Church of Gibborim elder, always at Aura's side
st: In season 1, Frances works for the Deans at the Church of Gibborim and, with Aura, is fooled by Chase and Molly's disguises.
In season 2, Frances escorts Frank to Jonah, then joins Frank's turn against Leslie when she moves to close the church.

files.notes: Named in S1E10, S2E5 ('Frances, Aura. Thank you. I'll take it from here'), S2E7 ('No, Frances. Vehicles do not get possessed'), S2E8, S2E10 (speaker-labelled FRANCES: 'Frank filled us in.'). Wikipedia cast notes match Aura's episodes. Not seen in S3.

add.k: A runaway taken in by the Church of Gibborim
st: In season 1, Destiny, a runaway who joins the Church of Gibborim, is sacrificed by PRIDE, and her body is found.
In the thin place, Destiny and the other sacrificed teens beg Karolina for help, then blame her and use her as bait.

files.notes: Named in the pilot's first scene by a voicemail ('Destiny? If this is you, please come home'); full name said in S1E3 ('I'm trying to track down Destiny Gonzalez'; news: 'body has been identified as Destiny Gonzalez'). Leslie talks her into going Ultra (S1E2). S3E5: 'We are the seventeen.' Not on screen in S2 (only her brother Oscar and the framing).

add.k: A popular Atlas Academy student who leads the dance team
st: In season 1, Eiffel blames Karolina for Chase's fight, takes Molly onto her dance team and offers Chase a dance ticket.
In season 2, Eiffel gets Chase a master key at Atlas, then tells the worried PRIDE parents what she saw.

files.notes: Named in S1E4 ('[Eiffel.] This is all your fault'), S1E7 ('Hi, Eiffel'), S1E9, S2E4 (speaker-labelled EIFFEL), S2E5 ('You don't need lawyers, Eiffel'). Only mentioned in S3E10. The dance team is never named on screen, so tm uses the school, the app's 'Atlas Academy'.

add.k: An LAPD detective on PRIDE's payroll
st: In season 1, Flores helps Tina cover up Amy's death and works the Destiny case, naming the kids suspects in her murder.
In season 2, Flores hunts the Runaways for PRIDE and seizes Molly, who breaks free; then his partner AWOL kills him.

files.notes: Named as 'Detective Flores' (S1E3 news, S1E10 amber alert, S2E1 'Detective Flores. Thank you for your assistance'), speaker-labelled FLORES in S2. On screen in S1E4 in the footage of the night Amy died (Nico: 'My mom sealing the house... Flores, the diary'); S1E10's framing is a news report. Wikipedia calls him a lieutenant; the screen says Detective. Also serves PRIDE ('the cop on PRIDE's payroll'), kept in notes rather than a second group, since he never leaves the LAPD. Killed by AWOL in S2E9.

add.k: A private investigator Tina Minoru hires
st: In season 1, Kincaid, Tina's hired investigator, finds the Yorkeses' hidden ranch for her and once caught Amy's Wizard hack.

files.notes: Named in S1E4 ('As always, Kincaid, thank you for your service' / 'As always, Tina, thank you for your money'); Tina then confronts the Yorkeses about the Yucatan ranch. S1E8 flashback: Amy tells him 'She put me on it' about the Wizard breach. S1E9: Nico suspects him ('Kincaid? He knew Amy was hacking Wizard'). Works for money, no group named: Independent. Raft file is a judgment call (he spies for Tina, not on the heroes directly).

add.k: A homeless biker who robs the Runaways
st: In season 2, Mike on a Bike steals Chase's Fistigons and the kids' money, then sells PRIDE news of them for fifty dollars.

files.notes: Named on screen in S2E1 ('Mike On A Bike's lost it!'; 'His nickname is Mike On A Bike'), speaker-labelled MIKE; S2E4 he tells the PRIDE parents about the kids and Robert pays him fifty dollars ('Mike, you might want to keep working on that asset-pricing model'). Wikipedia cast notes also list 213, not confirmed in the transcript.

add.k: Darius Davis's wife and Livvie's sister
st: In season 1, Tamar, pregnant with Darius's child, warns him he will get himself killed.
In season 2, Tamar loses Darius, deals with AWOL to spy on PRIDE, and gives Alex the gun Darius kept.
Tamar has inmates kill Catherine Wilder, shelters Leslie in labor, then makes a home with Geoffrey.

files.notes: Named in S1E5 and S1E9 ('Listen, I saw some shit, Tamar'), speaker-labelled TAMAR through S2 and S3. Livvie is her sister ('He's been seeing Tamar's sister'). S3E3: Wikipedia summary says Catherine is killed by inmates hired by Tamar ('Tamar says hello'). S3E6: Geoffrey has moved in; they work on Wizard's Corvus HQ in her neighborhood, which is a deal, not membership. No group named: Independent.

add.k: A loyal worker at the Church of Gibborim
st: In season 1, Vaughn, who works at the Church of Gibborim, doubts Karolina's friends but leads Chase and Molly to her.
In season 2, Vaughn tells Karolina that Leslie is held in the Crater, steals Aura's map and helps rescue her.
Vaughn quietly brings Leslie's mother to meet her, then runs the youth group at Leslie's reformed church.

files.notes: Only 'Vaughn' is said ('Vaughn, hi'; '"Yawn"? My name is Vaughn'); the surname Kaye was not found in the transcripts, so n is Vaughn. S3E3 'Thank you for convincing her' follows the summary's Leslie meeting her mother. S3E6: 'Leslie insisted I be given more responsibilities' / 'Aren't you just the youth group leader?'.

stages.title: Fantastic Four (2005)
stages.text: Leonard works as Victor's right hand at Von Doom Industries, briefing him on the falling stock and planning his press. On Victor's orders he fetches Ben Grimm to the Baxter Building, and in the end he sees the frozen Doom shipped to Latveria.
stages.whoA: His boss at Von Doom Industries
stages.whoB: His aide at Von Doom Industries

stages.title: Fantastic Four (2005)
stages.text: Ned's bank backs Von Doom Industries, and after the failed space mission he gives Victor one week to turn the stock around. When the bank pulls out, Victor, changed by the storm, kills him.
stages.whoA: The client he drops, who kills him
stages.whoB: The banker who pulls out, whom he kills

stages.title: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
stages.text: General Hager brings Mr. Sherman in to question the captured Silver Surfer and keeps the Fantastic Four out of the room. Hager later calls a break in the questioning.
stages.whoA: The general who brings him in
stages.whoB: The interrogator he calls in

stages.title: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
stages.text: Mr. Sherman questions the Silver Surfer in a military cell, saying the rules against torture don't apply because the Surfer isn't human. He tells the Surfer he should be more cooperative.
stages.whoA: The prisoner he interrogates
stages.whoB: His interrogator

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: After Bronaja's Terrigenesis, Maximus courts him as a seer, and Bronaja warns him the Genetic Council is plotting his death. Maximus later catches him lying about Tibor, makes him pledge loyalty, and pushes him into a vision of Maximus as undisputed king.
stages.whoA: The king who uses his visions
stages.whoB: His seer, who sees the future

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Auran leads Flora, Mordis and the rest of their Royal Guard team hunting the Royal Family on Oahu. Flora clears a path through the jungle and later helps guard Declan's facility, and the team is returned to Maximus under parley.
stages.whoA: The leader of her team on Oahu
stages.whoB: A plant-controlling guard on her team

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Flora and Mordis march through Oahu's jungle in Auran's team, and Mordis asks her to make a path. At Declan's facility she spots Karnak coming, and Mordis goes after him.
stages.whoA: A fellow guard on Auran's team
stages.whoB: A fellow guard who controls plants

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Flora spots Karnak approaching Declan's facility and warns her team, unsure whether shooting him is a trick. Karnak and Gorgon then beat Auran's party.
stages.whoA: A royal she hunts on Oahu
stages.whoB: A guard in the team hunting him

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Captain Pena holds the silent man his officers arrested and tells reporters there was no giant dog. He has him put in general population so the other inmates will rattle him into talking.
stages.whoA: The prisoner he will not explain
stages.whoB: The police captain holding him

stages.title: Inhumans
stages.text: Louise asks Captain Pena whether his prisoner showed powers and asks to see him, and he refuses. When she waits outside the station, he threatens to tow her car with her in it.
stages.whoA: A scientist pressing him about his prisoner
stages.whoB: The captain who stonewalls her

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Aura and Frances serve the church side by side and are rarely seen apart, and Chase and Molly fool them both in disguise. Later they escort Frank to Jonah, join his move against Leslie, and confront her together.
stages.whoA: Her constant partner in the church
stages.whoB: Her constant partner in the church

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Aura serves the church Leslie leads, alongside the other elder. When Leslie announces she is shutting the church down, Aura sides with Frank and tells her they won't let her.
stages.whoA: The church leader she turns against
stages.whoB: A church elder who turns on her

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Frank calls on Aura and the other elder after he kills Destiny's brother and tells them Leslie is the problem. Aura backs him when Leslie tries to close the church.
stages.whoA: Leslie's husband, whom she backs
stages.whoB: A church elder who backs him

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Aura and the other elder escort Frank to Jonah, who thanks them and sends them off. They head for Jonah's Ascension, which Aura calls a holy moment, until the Runaways hack their van.
stages.whoA: The church's hidden power she reveres
stages.whoB: A devoted church elder

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Frances serves the church Leslie leads, alongside the other elder. When Leslie announces she is shutting the church down, Frances sides with Frank and tells her they won't let her.
stages.whoA: The church leader she turns against
stages.whoB: A church elder who turns on her

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Frank calls on Frances and the other elder after he kills Destiny's brother and tells them Leslie is the problem. Frances backs him when Leslie tries to close the church.
stages.whoA: Leslie's husband, whom she backs
stages.whoB: A church elder who backs him

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Frances and the other elder escort Frank to Jonah, who thanks them and sends them off. They head for Jonah's Ascension, which Aura calls a holy moment, until the Runaways hack their van.
stages.whoA: The church's hidden power she reveres
stages.whoB: A devoted church elder

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Leslie talks Destiny into staying with the church to go Ultra, praising her plan to reclaim her child. At the ritual Destiny begs her, afraid, and Leslie tells her not to be afraid as PRIDE sacrifices her.
stages.whoA: The church leader who sacrifices her
stages.whoB: A runaway she sacrifices

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Victor runs the container used in PRIDE's ritual on Destiny and says she is gone. He later finds his machine failed and she is still alive inside it.
stages.whoA: The scientist whose machine holds her
stages.whoB: The girl left alive in his container

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Destiny meets Karolina at the church and asks for her number. When the kids see the ritual, Karolina refuses to believe Destiny is dead.
stages.whoA: A church girl she wants to befriend
stages.whoB: A runaway who wanted to be her friend

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: In the thin place, Destiny begs Karolina for help, then blames her as the face on the billboards that drew the seventeen to the church. She and the others use Karolina as bait before she escapes.
stages.whoA: The church's face, whom she blames
stages.whoB: A sacrificed girl who blames her

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Eiffel blames Karolina for Chase's fight with the lacrosse team and later offers him a free dance ticket and a dance. When he comes back to Atlas asking a favor, she gets him her master key, wanting something in return.
stages.whoA: A classmate she has a crush on
stages.whoB: A classmate with a crush on him

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Eiffel blames Karolina for the lacrosse fight and calls her a slut in front of the school. Karolina says she doesn't remember what Eiffel claims happened.
stages.whoA: A classmate she bullies
stages.whoB: A classmate who spreads rumors about her

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Molly asks Eiffel for a spot on the dance team after a failed audition, and Eiffel takes her on. Molly tells Gert that Eiffel appreciates her.
stages.whoA: A girl she takes onto her dance team
stages.whoB: The captain of her dance team

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Flores is at the Minoru house the night Amy dies, asking Tina where Robert is while she handles things, and he later works the Destiny case for PRIDE.
stages.whoA: A PRIDE leader he covers for
stages.whoB: The detective on PRIDE's payroll

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Tina takes command of PRIDE's hunt for the kids, and Flores runs it. After Molly escapes him, Tina agrees to replace him with AWOL.
stages.whoA: A PRIDE leader he answers to
stages.whoB: The cop PRIDE drops

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Geoffrey is among the PRIDE parents Flores brings to the wrong kids. After Molly escapes him, Geoffrey says Flores is out and hands the strike team to AWOL.
stages.whoA: A PRIDE member who drops him
stages.whoB: The cop PRIDE pays

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Leslie calls Flores to cover up Frank's killing of Destiny's brother. He arrives joking that PRIDE keeps him busy and is impressed Frank did it.
stages.whoA: A PRIDE member he cleans up for
stages.whoB: The cop who hides Frank's killing

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: AWOL is Flores's partner on PRIDE's strike team, and Flores tells him to stay in line about the kids' powers. AWOL goes to PRIDE, takes Flores's job and kills him.
stages.whoA: His partner, who kills him
stages.whoB: His corrupt partner, whom he kills

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Flores captures Molly, claims he was a friend of her parents, and threatens to hurt her for answers. Her friends rescue her, and Molly throws him aside.
stages.whoA: A runaway he captures
stages.whoB: The corrupt cop who captures her

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Tina pays Kincaid to investigate for her, and he brings her proof of the Yorkeses' hidden ranch, thanked as always for his service. Before that, she put him on the Wizard breach that led to Amy.
stages.whoA: The client who pays him
stages.whoB: Her hired investigator

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Mike on a Bike steals Chase's Fistigons and blasts them around a homeless camp, and Chase chases him down to get them back. Mike later tells PRIDE the pretty boy grabbed the gloves.
stages.whoA: The kid whose gloves he steals
stages.whoB: The biker who steals his Fistigons

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Old Lace corners Mike on a Bike when the Runaways chase him, and he begs to be left alone. He later tells PRIDE he wants to say the kids had a dinosaur.
stages.whoA: The dinosaur that scares him
stages.whoB: A biker she scares off

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Tamar, pregnant with Darius's son, warns him he will get himself killed. He tells her he saw a girl who glows and a little one who lifts an SUV.
stages.whoA: Her husband
stages.whoB: His wife

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Tamar and Darius ready the nursery with Alex's help and plan their new life. Darius is killed before their son Xerxes is born.
stages.whoA: Her husband
stages.whoB: His wife

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Tamar's sister Livvie stays close after Darius dies, and AWOL holds Tamar and the baby to force Livvie to help him. Afterward Tamar tells Alex that he and Livvie are done.
stages.whoA: Her sister
stages.whoB: Her sister

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Geoffrey signs the property over to Tamar, but she blames him for Darius's death and secretly reports on PRIDE to AWOL. She turns down the security he offers.
stages.whoA: Darius's old friend, whom she distrusts
stages.whoB: Darius's widow, who distrusts him

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: Tamar lets Geoffrey reach Alex through her phone. Later he moves in with her and Nana B, and they work together on Wizard's new headquarters in her neighborhood.
stages.whoA: Darius's old friend, now her partner
stages.whoB: Darius's widow, now his partner

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Catherine has AWOL fire on Tamar's house as a warning, with a newborn inside.
stages.whoA: The woman who shot at her family
stages.whoB: A widow whose house she has shot up

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: In prison, Catherine is told Tamar says hello before inmates hired by Tamar kill her.
stages.whoA: The woman she has killed
stages.whoB: The widow who has her killed

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: AWOL fires on Tamar's house, then she cuts a deal to keep him in the loop on PRIDE if he leaves her family alone. He later holds her and the baby to force Livvie's help.
stages.whoA: The hitman she makes a deal with
stages.whoB: A widow he threatens and deals with

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Alex paints the nursery for Darius and eats at Tamar's table, and she warns him about AWOL. She later hands him the gun Darius kept with his prints on it, but tells him to stay away from Livvie.
stages.whoA: Darius's young friend
stages.whoB: Darius's wife

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: Alex brings Leslie in labor to Tamar's house, but he is not himself and turns on Tamar when she fights back.
stages.whoA: Darius's young friend, acting strange
stages.whoB: Darius's widow, who shelters him

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Vaughn works for the Deans at the church and calls them his family, and Leslie thanks him for his loyalty after Karolina escapes. When Frank has her reconditioned she cries out for Vaughn, and he later helps free her from the Crater.
stages.whoA: The church leader he serves
stages.whoB: Her loyal assistant at the church

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: Vaughn quietly brings Leslie's mother to meet her. At Leslie's reformed church he gets more duties and runs the youth group.
stages.whoA: The church leader he serves
stages.whoB: Her loyal helper at the church

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Karolina's friends beg Vaughn for help finding her at the church, and he leads Chase and Molly to her. Later he tells Karolina her mother is held in the Crater, steals the map and joins the rescue.
stages.whoA: Leslie's daughter, whom he helps
stages.whoB: A church worker who helps her

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: Vaughn greets Karolina at Leslie's new church and tells her Leslie will be happy to see her.
stages.whoA: Leslie's daughter
stages.whoB: A worker at her mother's church

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Frank tries to make Vaughn his new assistant while poking around the church archives. Later Frank demands to know where Leslie is, and Vaughn tells him before Frank has her reconditioned.
stages.whoA: Leslie's husband at the church
stages.whoB: A church worker

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Molly sneaks into the church in disguise with Chase, and Vaughn leads them to Karolina. Later Molly joins Vaughn on the Crater rescue and teases him as Brawnster.
stages.whoA: A runaway he helps
stages.whoB: The church worker on her rescue team

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: Molly volunteers at Leslie's church, where Vaughn runs the youth group and keeps an eye out for her.
stages.whoA: A volunteer at his church
stages.whoB: The youth group leader at the church
